description: This file defines the ClusterConfig interface and an enum ClusterConfigValue for cluster configuration settings in the Ditto service. It provides methods for retrieving the number of shards and cluster roles blocklist, with default values specified in the enum.

classes.name: ClusterConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings for the Ditto cluster, including methods to get the number of shards and roles blocklist.

classes.name: ClusterConfig.ClusterConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue that defines known configuration path expressions and their default values for the cluster.

methods.name: getNumberOfShards
methods.description: Returns the number of shards in a cluster.

methods.name: getClusterStatusRolesBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the collection of cluster roles that should be excluded when determining cluster status/health.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path for this config value.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with this config value.
